name: Lichtenau (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lichtenau (a white castle on blue above a fleur-de-lis).
history: Municipal flag of Lichtenau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
